messages.subject: FFT from Eigen
parts:
I'm going to try to switch over to the Eigen FFT.

It has a nicer C++ interface and
it'll simplify the licensing (they got the KissFFT
author to give them a direct LGPL license so they could roll
it into Eigen proper) and the C++ interface is nicer.
It may even be faster if they use their object to hold
a suitable cache between calls.

It should be pretty easy to get working now that
Matt explained how all this works and we have a working
test case. Just need to sort out the padding and
scaling issues.

- Bob
